shellCommands.command: git status --short && git log --oneline | head -5 && find . -path ./node_modules -prune -o -path ./.git -prune -o -type f -print | head -100 && cat package.json 2>/dev/null

cat src/App.tsx && echo ---MAIN--- && cat src/main.tsx && echo ---IDX--- && cat index.html && echo ---TSCONF--- && cat tsconfig.json && echo ---VITE--- && cat vite.config.ts && echo ---ENV--- && cat src/vite-env.d.ts && echo ---GITIGNORE--- && cat .gitignore && echo ---RUN--- && head -50 __agent_eval__/run.mjs

ls node_modules 2>/dev/null | head -3; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/dist 2>/dev/null | head -50; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/package.json 2>/dev/null | grep '"version"'; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/dist/components/Dialog 2>/dev/null

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit && ls; ls dist | head -80; ls dist/components 2>/dev/null | tr '\n' ' '; echo; ls dist/components/Dialog 2>/dev/null; cat dist/components/Dialog/index.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -20

ls build | head -40; ls build/esm/components 2>/dev/null | tr '\n' ' '; echo; ls build/esm/components/Dialog 2>/dev/null; ls build/esm/components/Modal 2>/dev/null; ls build/esm/components/Dialog/ 2>/dev/null | head -30

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components && cat Dialog/Dialog.d.ts; echo ---FOOTER---; cat Dialog/DialogFooter/DialogFooter.d.ts 2>/dev/null || ls Dialog/DialogFooter; echo ---HEADER---; cat Dialog/DialogHeader/DialogHeader.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -30; echo ---BODY---; cat Dialog/DialogBody/DialogBody.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -30; echo ---BTN---; sed -n 1,60p Button/Button.d.ts

cd /home/sandbox/workspace && ls node_modules/.bin 2>/dev/null | grep -E '^(tsc|vite)$'; timeout 170000 npx --no-install tsc --noEmit 2>&1 | tail -20; echo "tsc exit: ${PIPESTATUS[0]}"; timeout 170000 npx --no-install vite build 2>&1 | tail -15
